title: Single Piece Armor Sets
description: Adds armor pieces that equip and unequip in one piece.
body:
# Single Piece Armor Sets

This datapack adds new craftable armor pieces that equip and unequip in one piece, like the Ancient Hero's Aspect from Nintendo's Tears of the Kingdom. See more about it in [this YouTube playlist](https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PL3bpGEPTNUMGFC7nkJbxM85VU5630CLG-). It is outdated as of now, but only the recipe changes, I think. Check the gallery for recipes.

## Armor Suits with Extra Functionality

* Creeper Suit - Sneak for 2 seconds to trigger an explosion
* Rocket Suit - Sneak for 10 seconds to boost into the air as long as you continue sneaking
* Chicken Suit - You lay an egg every 5 minutes, like the chicken mob

## Suits That Apply Effects

* Magma Cube - Fire Resistance
* Miner's - Haste & Night Vision
* Unicorn - Regeneration, and burst of Saturation and Instant Health every 10 seconds

## Repair Items

* Alchemist Suit - Amethyst Block
* Ancient Hero's Aspect - Unbreakable
* Chicken Suit - Any Egg
* Creeper Suit - Gunpowder
* God Suit - Unbreakable
* Magma Cube Suit - Magma Cream
* Medieval Armor Suit - Iron Ingot
* Miner's Suit - Glowstone Dust
* Rocket Suit - Dragon's Breath
* Snow Suit - Leather
* Space Suit - Iron Ingot, Glass
* Unicorn Suit - End Rod

## Usage

Please credit me if you use this datapack in any sort of public or profitable manner.
